about: The offertorium of the formulary “12th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Moses prayed in the sight of the Lord his God and said: Why, O Lord, are You angry with Your people? Restrain the wrath of Your soul; remember Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to whom You swore to give a land flowing with milk and honey. And the Lord was appeased concerning the evil which He had said He would do to His people.
